description: MicroBooNE wire planes for --plane-geometry and --sp-build, in the open-data file's coordinates. Wire coordinates fitted against spacepoint positions (10-11): u = -0.866 y + 0.5 z + 101.44, v = 0.866 y + 0.5 z + 99.76, y = z - 0.25; hit drift coordinate = x + 44. Resolutions are the 0.3 cm wire pitch and one 0.5 us tick at a nominal 0.111 cm/us drift velocity. active_volume is the TPC, cm.
